items.name: Eastbank Hearing
items.purpose: Cross-source reopening with six independent settlement dimensions.
invariants: A hearing settlement changes arrangements, not historical Truth.
Deep cause remains an open bounded inquiry, not a revealed cosmology.
generationEnvelope: Ordinary hearing wording only; no invented votes, powers or erased rights.

canon.entry: Acquired independent source roles establish incomplete account, deliberate policy, present dependence and active contradiction.
canon.truth: P7_PRIVATE_HEARING: the hearing negotiates a present compact over incomplete surviving evidence. No participating institution owns complete Eastbank Truth or can erase all dependence on the old settlement.
evidenceGraph: Burial or press evidence: incomplete official account
Corporate charter plus independent continuity: deliberate stabilization
Property or corporate continuing rights: present dependence
Supervised residual comparison after reopening: ordinary explanations remain incomplete
pressures: Day eighteen standardization begins. Day twenty-four interoperable records lock unless a qualified compact has been filed.
Late hearing may issue remedies but cannot erase exclusions or the lock event.
routes: Property + company + press; burial and railway may be missed.
Burial + railway + company; accident and press may be missed.
interventions: Compare retained residual carriers with Academy custody
Submit a six-dimensional compact or adjourn
settlements: Independent historical disclosure, stability, justice, political power, religious authority and accountability terms
consequences: Current compact binds participating desks; higher state reversal is not claimed.
Compensation duty, review access and source exposure depend on chosen terms.
canon.eastbankContribution: Four interpretive layers reinterpret surviving evidence; the fourth exposes limits of the present theory without finalizing deep cause.
reentry: Amend the current compact without erasing its occurrence history.
canon.failureContinuity: Adjournment and late reopening retain sources and current people; clock pressure continues.

perspective.publicDescription: A qualified Eastbank reopening can negotiate evidence disclosure, current stability, compensation, public power, sacred recognition and responsibility separately.
